name: NeedsList
location_or_channel: Global web platform; Turkey-Syria 2023 with Google.org; no Philippine use found
price_of_comparable_item: Free to post needs; revenue from commissions on enterprise users (https://www.hypepotamus.com/needslist/)
what_it_sells: Nonprofits post needs for supplies, volunteers or funds; donors search and fill them, like a registry

name: iVolunteer Philippines
price_of_comparable_item: Free for volunteers; Treasure Volunteer takes donations per cause
what_it_sells: Matches volunteers to NGO opportunities; donation drives such as Typhoon Crising 2025 (https://www.ivolunteer.com.ph/treasure-volunteer/9739)
positioning_line: Founded after Ondoy 2009 so volunteers can find groups that need them (https://blog.ivolunteer.com.ph/about/)

name: DSWD DROMIC
location_or_channel: National government; reports and Facebook posts
what_it_sells: Official counts of evacuees and open evacuation centers; no donor-facing needs list found
positioning_line: Disaster Response Operations Monitoring and Information Center
source_date: 2026-10-26 (dashboard itself not reached; known through news citing it)

name: Rappler Project Agos
location_or_channel: National crowdsourced alert and relief map
what_it_sells: Maps rescue and relief requests from SMS 2929 and hashtags like #ReliefPH, validated by volunteers, handed to NDRRMC and Red Cross
positioning_line: Combines top-down government action with bottom-up civic engagement

name: Angat Buhay / Angat Bayanihan Network
location_or_channel: Naga City and Bicol; social media posts and drop-off points
price_of_comparable_item: Free to donate to; cash via Kaya Natin
what_it_sells: Donation drives with posted urgent-needs lists, hot meals and relief packs; volunteer network

name: APSEMO Infoboard and Albay emergency app
what_it_sells: Warnings and advisories pushed to barangay captains, mayors, DepEd; 2011 Smart-built app for officials
source_date: 2026-10-26 (app is from 2011; no evacuee needs feature found)

name: Sahana Eden
location_or_channel: Open-source disaster management system; adopted by NDCC in 2009
what_it_sells: Disaster management software built by volunteers, supported by IBM

name: Facebook pages and group chats
what_it_sells: Centers, parishes and NGOs post needs; donors message or show up

name: LGU and DSWD donation desks with published lists
location_or_channel: City hall desks and drop-off points
what_it_sells: One desk receives all donations and publishes what is needed; asks donors not to go straight to centers

name: Give cash to a trusted NGO
location_or_channel: Bank and e-wallet transfers to NGOs
what_it_sells: The NGO decides what to buy and where it goes
